title: NMOS source follower (common-drain buffer)
description: Design an NMOS source-follower (common-drain) unity-gain buffer, current-source biased, that holds small-signal voltage gain between 0.80 and 0.90 V/V at 1 kHz across the full sky130-style tt/ss/ff process corner, 1.62-1.98 V supply, and -40..125 C temperature matrix.

target_specs.corners: sky130-style tt/ss/ff process x 1.62-1.98V supply x -40..125C

reference.notes: Real sky130 device (sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8) via $PDK_ROOT -- see sf.spice's own header for why body effect (absent from the LEVEL=1 generic model this replaces) caps real gain around 0.83-0.84 V/V, well short of the original 0.90-0.999 V/V generic-model band.

source.citation: Source follower is a standard first analog IC design course topic; framed here in the style of AnalogCoder's (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) easy-tier task set, not reproduced from that repo (unlicensed).
